reason: The Oaks Academy (Indianapolis classical Christian K-12, ~1,000 students across 3 campuses) is the right vertical and size band, but it already has in-house technology leadership -- a Chief Technology Officer (Michael Updike, 10+ years, 'leading the IT operations and infrastructure... managing a team of IT professionals') plus a full-time IT Systems Administrator -- which is the exact opposite of Kenneth's target situation ('schools that have outgrown reactive outsourced IT but have no technology leadership'); separately, the matched posting is a Lower School Academic Interventionist (literacy/math RTI teaching role) and every other live opening is teaching or before/after-care staff, so there is no quotable line from any live posting that redescribes technology-governance, vendor-oversight, or AI-policy pain.
